description: This file defines API endpoints for managing licenses in the Mattermost server, including adding, removing, and retrieving client license information.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Represents the API handler with route initialization for license management.

methods.name: InitLicenseLocal
methods.description: Initializes license-related API routes for adding, removing, and fetching license data.

methods.name: localAddLicense
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a new license file.

methods.name: localRemoveLicense
methods.description: Handles removal of the current license.

methods.name: localGetClientLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the client license information in specified format.
